scientific_integrity: Exact integer chain and Smith computations with standalone reproducibility code; no external or independent proof certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The integral gluing group is classified only for the independence complex of the rank-three binary Fano matroid and its full GL_3(F_2) action; neither the full integral group module nor any general family is classified. Publication priority and independent proof audit remain unconfirmed.
title: An integral 64-fold gluing obstruction in Fano-matroid homology
